itens.texto:
O candidato à Presidência da República Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) negou que vai mudar a forma de aumento para as aposentadorias e o Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC) para cortar gastos se for eleito. Segundo o jornal Folha de S.Paulo, essa ideia foi apresentada ao mercado pela equipe de economia da campanha de Flávio.
“Eu não vou fazer economia em cima de quem precisa. Das pessoas mais carentes desse Brasil. Aposentado, fique tranquilo. Não cai nessa fake news do PT dizendo que eu vou acabar com reajuste aposentadoria. Pelo contrário”, afirmou em conversa com jornalistas depois de receber o apoio formal do Podemos.

itens.titulo: Is Hess Midstream (HESM) Undervalued Following Chevron's Deal And Revised Bakken Contracts?
itens.descricao: Is Hess Midstream (HESM) Undervalued Following Chevron's Deal And Revised Bakken Contracts? Yahoo Finance Singapore
trechos: Hess Midstream (HESM) is back in focus after Chevron agreed to transfer its ownership interests and DJ Basin midstream assets in exchange for revised Bakken contracts and a US$200 million cash payment.

The Hess Midstream share price has come under pressure since the Chevron announcement, with a 1-day share price return of down 14.63% and a 30-day share price return of down 17.24%, as investors react to the revised earnings guidance and ownership changes.

Despite that short term drop, total shareholder return of 7.51% over 1 year and 84.22% over 5 years points to longer term holders still being ahead, although recent momentum is clearly fading for now.

Scan beyond Hess Midstream and compare this selloff with hand-picked midstream and infrastructure operators by reviewing the 43 power grid technology and infrastructure stocks that could be setting up for the next move.
Most Popular Narrative: 12% Undervalued On the most followed narrative, Hess Midstream screens as undervalued, with a fair value of $37.50 against a last close of $33.03.

Hess Midstream is moving into a capital lighter phase as total capital expenditures are expected to fall from about US$270 million in 2025 to approximately US$150 million in 2026 and then to less than US$75 million per year in 2027 and 2028.
See why 40 investors see Hess Midstream as 12% undervalued.
Result: Fair Value of $37.50 (UNDERVALUED) Still, the Hess Midstream story can wobble if Chevron reduces Bakken output sooner than expected or if minimum volume protection fades faster after 2028.

itens.descricao: O rali das small caps Brazil Journal
trechos: No rali desta semana, 18 ações subiram mais de 20% em três pregões.
Dessas, 17 estão no índice de small caps – a exceção é a Localiza, que valorizou 20,5% no período – e apenas sete fazem parte do Ibovespa (e com pesos reduzidos).

Depois de subir 7,7% na segunda-feira, o Ibovespa caiu 1,3% nos dois pregões seguintes – e opera em alta de 0,6% por volta das 11h, num dia complicado no exterior, com petróleo subindo e bolsas em queda.
Já o índice de small caps subiu 12% entre segunda e quarta – e avança mais 1% hoje.

“Muitos olham o Ibovespa e acreditam que o movimento de segunda parou nos dias seguintes, mas não foi o que se viu no restante do mercado,” Fernando Ferreira, estrategista-chefe da XP, disse ao Brazil Journal.

No acumulado dos três últimos pregões, as ações que mais subiram foram Quero-Quero, com alta de 47%, Movida (33%), Ecorodovias (31%), Pague Menos (31%), Simpar (28%), Vamos (27%) e Grupo SBF (26%), segundo um levantamento da consultoria Elos Ayta.
“Esse movimento tem um teto porque depende de quanto o gestor consegue mexer na carteira.
O ingresso de recursos nos fundos de ações ainda deve demorar,” disse Ferreira.

itens.titulo: JPMorgan's Shares Before Q3 Earnings: Buy Now or Wait for Results?
itens.descricao: JPMorgan's Shares Before Q3 Earnings: Buy Now or Wait for Results? Yahoo Finance
trechos: JPMorgan JPM is slated to report third-quarter 2026 earnings on Oct.
JPM started 2026 on a strong footing, with robust trading activity, IB performance and commercial loan demand supporting first-half revenues of $108.6 billion.
The Zacks Consensus Estimate for revenues of $52.21 billion suggests a 12.5% year-over-year rise.
In the past week, the consensus estimate for third-quarter earnings has moved higher to $5.94.
This indicates a 17.2% jump from the prior-year quarter.
Its earnings outpaced the Zacks Consensus Estimate in each of the trailing four quarters, with the average beat being 7.33%.
After robust lending activity in the first half of 2026, the momentum is likely to have normalized during the to-be-reported quarter.
The Zacks Consensus Estimate for NII (reported) of $27 billion suggests a 12.5% increase on a year-over-year basis.
